events.title: 화북이 금에 넘어간 산둥 역성에서 태어나다
events.title_en: Born in Licheng, Shandong, already under Jin rule
events.description: 산둥 역성(지금의 제남)에서 태어났다. 그가 태어났을 때 화북 땅은 이미 여진족 금나라에 짓밟혀 있었다.
events.description_en: He was born in Licheng, in what is now Jinan, Shandong. By the time of his birth, the whole of north China already lay under the Jurchen Jin dynasty.

events.title: 의병 이천을 모아 항금 봉기군에 가담하다
events.title_en: He raised two thousand men to join the anti-Jin uprising
events.description: 금나라가 대대적으로 남송을 치자 스물두 살의 신기질은 제남에서 의병 이천 명을 모았다. 경경이 이끄는 봉기군에 합류해 장서기를 맡았다.
events.description_en: When the Jin launched a massive invasion of the Song, the twenty-two-year-old Xin Qiji raised two thousand volunteers in Jinan. He joined the uprising led by Geng Jing and served as its record-keeper.

events.title: 오십여 명으로 적진을 기습해 반역자를 사로잡다
events.title_en: He raided the enemy camp with fifty men and seized a traitor
events.description: 경경이 부장 장안국에게 살해되고 봉기군이 무너지자, 신기질은 오십여 명을 이끌고 수만 명이 진 친 적진을 기습해 장안국을 붙잡았다.
events.description_en: After Geng Jing was murdered by his own officer Zhang Anguo and the uprising collapsed, Xin Qiji led about fifty men in a raid on an enemy camp tens of thousands strong and captured Zhang Anguo.

events.title: 장안국을 넘기고 남송으로 귀순하다
events.title_en: He handed over the traitor and crossed south to the Song
events.description: 사로잡은 장안국을 건강의 남송 조정으로 끌고 가 처형시켰다. 이 일로 남송 조정에 이름이 알려지며 관직을 받고 남으로 귀순했다.
events.description_en: He marched the captured Zhang Anguo to the Song court at Jiankang, where the traitor was executed. The feat made his name known at court, and he was given office as he crossed over to the Song.

events.title: 미근십론을 조정에 올리다
events.title_en: He submitted the Ten Discourses on Recovery to the throne
events.description: 금을 물리치고 화북을 되찾을 방책을 담은 미근십론을 조정에 바쳤다. 조정은 이를 받아들이지 않았다.
events.description_en: He presented the throne with the Ten Discourses on Recovery, laying out a strategy to defeat the Jin and reclaim the north. The court did not act on it.

events.title: 상요에 가헌을 짓다
events.title_en: He built the estate of Jiaxuan at Shangrao
events.description: 강서 상요의 대호 가에 별장을 짓고 가헌이라 이름 붙였다. 훗날 호를 가헌거사로 삼았다.
events.description_en: He built a country estate beside Lake Dai in Shangrao, Jiangxi, and named it Jiaxuan. He later took Jiaxuan as his own literary name.

events.title: 탄핵을 받아 파직되다
events.description: 간관들의 탄핵을 받아 관직에서 쫓겨났다. 이후 상요와 연산을 오가며 오래 은거했다.
events.description_en: He was impeached by court censors and stripped of office. He spent long years afterward in seclusion, moving between Shangrao and Qianshan.

events.title: 가헌사 육백여 수를 남기다
events.title_en: He left over six hundred poems known as the Jiaxuan lyrics
events.description: 평생에 걸쳐 가헌사로 불리는 사(詞) 육백이십여 수를 지었다. 호방한 기개와 못다 이룬 회복의 뜻을 담아 송사 작가 중 가장 많은 작품을 남겼다.
events.description_en: Over his lifetime he wrote more than six hundred and twenty ci poems known as the Jiaxuan lyrics. Bold in spirit and heavy with his unfulfilled hope of recovering the north, they made him the most prolific of all Song ci poets.

events.title: 예순넷에 소흥지부로 복직되다
events.title_en: He was recalled to office at sixty-four as prefect of Shaoxing
events.description: 북벌을 주장한 한탁주가 주전파를 다시 기용하며 예순네 살의 신기질을 소흥지부 겸 절동안무사로 불러들였다.
events.description_en: When Han Tuozhou, who favored a northern campaign, recalled the war faction to office, the sixty-four-year-old Xin Qiji was named prefect of Shaoxing and pacification commissioner of eastern Zhejiang.

events.title: 진강 북고정에 올라 회고사를 짓다
events.title_en: He climbed Beigu Pavilion at Zhenjiang and wrote a poem of remembrance
events.description: 진강지부로 옮겨 북고정에 올라 나라를 되찾을 길 없는 회한을 노래한 영우락·경구북고정회고를 지었다. 이후 간관의 공격을 받아 다시 물러났다.
events.description_en: Transferred to Zhenjiang as prefect, he climbed Beigu Pavilion and wrote 'Yongyule: Meditation on the Past at Beigu Pavilion, Jingkou,' voicing his grief at never recovering the lost north. He was again forced from office under attack from court censors.

events.title: 연산에서 예순여덟에 눈감다
events.title_en: He died at Qianshan at sixty-eight
events.description: 조정이 다시 그를 추밀도승지로 불렀으나 이미 병으로 자리에서 일어나지 못했다. 사직을 청하는 상소를 올린 뒤 연산에서 숨을 거두었다. 죽기 직전 적을 죽이라고 외쳤다는 이야기가 전한다.
events.description_en: The court recalled him once more, this time as vice commissioner of military affairs, but by then illness had confined him to bed. After submitting a petition to resign, he died at Qianshan. Tradition holds that with his last breath he cried out to kill the enemy.

events.title: 소사로 추증되고 충민이라는 시호를 받다
events.title_en: He was posthumously honored as Junior Preceptor with the title Zhongmin
events.description: 사후 오랜 시간이 지나 소사로 추증되고 충민이라는 시호를 받았다.
events.description_en: Long after his death he was posthumously granted the rank of Junior Preceptor and the honorific title Zhongmin.
